The stroke-order data files in this directory (assets/vendor/hanzi-data/*.js)
are wrapped, unmodified per-character JSON from the hanzi-writer-data package
(https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data), which derives from the
Make Me a Hanzi project (https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi).

Make Me a Hanzi's graphical data derives from Arphic Technology's fonts and is
licensed under the Arphic Public License. A copy of that license is available
at https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/blob/master/APL.txt — under its
terms this notice and that license travel with the data.

The Hanzi Writer library itself (assets/vendor/hanzi-writer.min.js) is MIT
licensed; see hanzi-writer-LICENSE.txt alongside this file.
